Name: Palestine Poster and Flag Set for Alternative Textures
Author: chichisribbons
Description: Mod includes two flags and six posters in different orientations that allow Stardew Valley players to add Palestinian content to their game. Previously DGA but now AT to be compatible with 1.6! All proceeds from downloads will be donated here: [url=http://tiltify.com/@saeeddicaprio/pcrf]SaeedDiCaprio's Tiltify Event for Palestinian Children's Relief Fund[/url] ♡

Downloads.Description: Optionally replaces nearly all in-game paintings with Palestinian flags and For Palestine posters. Check texture catalogue in AT!

Manifest.Name: (AT) Free Palestine Posters
Manifest.Description: An Alternative Textures (AT) pack that adds flags, signs, and posters to show support for Palestine!
